title: Key Vault use — spoken follow-up
situation: In a technical discussion, a teammate suggests copying a sensitive value into configuration. You must answer aloud accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Deliver a sixty-second answer with decision, evidence, limitation and one clarifying question.

vocabulary.meaning: the precise concept required for key vault use
an observation supported by a reproducible check

expectedElements: A clear decision tied to the scenario
Verified evidence and one explicit limitation
modelAnswer: My decision is that The repository stores only the vault location; the runtime identity retrieves the sensitive value and logs never include it. The current evidence is limited to the documented checks, so I would not claim more. Which constraint or observation would make us revisit this decision?
